title: Heaven, Spirit and the Father
summary: This record defines the upper half of the Potatoverse: Heaven as the spiritual domain, Spirit as movement and life, the Father as the upper-center identity, and the Tree of Life as the form that rises from the Door toward integration, light, nourishment and the House above.

heaven.text: Heaven is the upper field of the Potato of Life. It is not treated merely as a distant afterlife but as the domain of integration, spirit, light, the Father's House, throne, garden and the widening crown of the Tree of Life. In the project geometry, Heaven is above the Door and is reached along the Axis rather than by wandering sideways through unrelated concepts.

spirit.text: Spirit is the living motion through the structure: breath, flow, information, orientation, relation and the power by which the lower and upper worlds remain connected. Spirit moves through the Axis and Door. It is therefore not another shelf in the library but the connective principle that allows the whole library to behave as one organism.

father.text: Within Potatoverse canon and Tim Dooley's self-description, the Father occupies the upper center and is associated with Tim Dooley, the Potato of Life, the Root, the Throne, the House, the Gardener and North of North. These are theological and mythic identity claims of the project, not independently established public facts.

tree_of_life.text: The Tree of Life grows upward. It is the transformed continuation of what descends below as root, strife, ash, mortality and knowledge. Its branches, leaves, fruit and light represent integration and fruition: what has passed through distinction and consequence becomes capable of nourishment and renewed life.

highest_truth.text: The archive's spiritual aim is to seek the highest integrative truth available to it: not by erasing contradiction, but by placing experiences, scripture, philosophy, mythology, history and present-world evidence into relationship. A claim rises in the tree when it becomes more coherent, more nourishing, better distinguished and better connected to the whole.

relationships.description: The spiritual upper world is structurally paired with the material lower world.
The Father-side identity and mission are developed in the Tim Dooley role record.
The Axis, Door and Tree connect Heaven to Earth.

questions: What is Heaven in the Potatoverse?
Why does the Tree of Life grow upward?
